tandemFrageBeispiel.antwort: Yes, we even enjoyed the rain.

tandemSoGehts: Cut the cards in the middle. Partner A takes the left half, Partner B the right half.
A builds question 1 from the tiles and asks it: "Who passed the exam?"

B builds the answer from the tiles. Put the blue verb into the right form. The focus word (only, even, also, too, as well) goes next to the word it is about: before it for only and even, in the middle for also, at the end for too and as well.
Then B asks question 2 and A answers. Take turns. At the end, check with the answer sheet.
Swap cards and do it all again, faster.
